verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail documents that physical items can be forwarded and lists per-shipment fees for international and expedited forwarding, so self-service forwarding exists in some form. Nothing in the evidence describes how that forwarding works in practice. Missing for 10: rule-based or automatic forwarding, one-click forwarding, saved recipient addresses, carrier choice, cost shown before confirming, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, I can forward mail with rules or one click — saved recipients, carrier choice, and cost shown before I confirm — rather than emailing support
